_comment: This is the source of truth for who is CURRENTLY on the roster, updated by hand whenever membership changes. It is intentionally NOT derived from seasons.json, because roster membership is a real-world fact that doesn't wait for stats to exist (e.g. a brand-new manager has zero games played but is still 'current'). compute_managers.py reads this file to set each manager's status field. Update this the moment a membership change happens, not when the season's data eventually gets entered.
